name: Rolling window: old days drop out on a later date

planSteps.description: Navigate to /?today=2026-10-19&fresh=1 (pins today to 2026-10-19 and clears saved trips)
Click the add trip button (data-testid=trip-add), enter entry 2026-05-01 and exit 2026-05-30 and click save (data-testid=trip-save)

Read the DOM text of the calculator tile data-testid=days-used (a <dd> inside the calculator's status panel, data-testid=status-panel). Do NOT use the landing band (data-testid=band-used) higher up the page: it is exactly "30"
Navigate to exactly /?today=2026-11-15 . The URL must NOT contain fresh=1 (fresh=1 deletes the saved trip and would break this test)
In the Trips list there is exactly one trip row (data-testid=trip-row) whose text contains "2026-05-01 to 2026-05-30"

Read the DOM text of the calculator tile data-testid=days-used (a <dd> inside the calculator's status panel, data-testid=status-panel). Do NOT use the landing band (data-testid=band-used) higher up the page: it is exactly "11", because only 2026-05-20 to 2026-05-30 is inside the 180 days ending 2026-11-15
